title: A photorealistic cinematic vertical clos
prompt:
A photorealistic cinematic vertical close-up portrait of a clearly adult young woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, leaning toward the camera in a bright indoor bathroom or vanity area. Her specific ethnicity or race is left unspecified because it cannot be reliably determined from appearance alone. She has very fair, luminous skin with soft neutral-to-cool undertones, realistic fine skin texture, smooth softly contoured cheeks, a delicate oval-to-heart-shaped face, a narrow tapered jawline, a small refined nose with a softly rounded tip, naturally full coral-pink lips slightly parted, neatly groomed dark eyebrows, and large dark-brown almond-shaped eyes looking directly into the lens. Her makeup is polished and feminine, with subtle brown eyeliner, softly defined lashes, warm peach-pink eyeshadow, gentle rosy blush, lightly sculpted cheekbones, and glossy gradient pink-red lipstick. Her expression is calm, intimate, slightly playful, and self-assured.

Her hair is extremely long, thick, glossy, and deep black, parted slightly off-center and swept dramatically over her right shoulder. The hair falls in loose natural waves down past her chest and toward the bottom edge of the frame, with individual flyaway strands crossing her forehead and cheeks for realistic texture and movement.

She wears a revealing ivory-white lace-trimmed camisole or lingerie-style top exactly as shown, with thin adjustable shoulder straps, visible metal/plastic strap adjusters, delicate lace edging, textured ribbed fabric, and an extremely deep plunging neckline. The garment fits closely to her torso and exposes substantial cleavage while remaining opaque. Do not add jackets, jewelry, necklaces, or additional garments.

Her upper body fills most of the frame. She leans forward slightly with her shoulders angled unevenly, head tilted toward one shoulder, one arm descending along the side of her torso, creating a casual close-range selfie composition. The background is a compact bathroom storage area with pale tiled walls, white wire or mesh shelving, hooks, bottles, tubes, and a white spray bottle, all softly out of focus.

Use bright diffused overhead bathroom lighting mixed with soft frontal illumination, gentle shadows, creamy highlights, natural skin translucency, shallow depth of field, approximately a 35mm-equivalent smartphone portrait lens at close range, subtle perspective distortion, crisp facial focus, restrained sharpening, clean pastel-neutral color grading, low contrast, and realistic high-resolution photographic detail. 3:4.
